propositions: reconcile.py is the largest module-size gate offender at 1093 LOC and must graduate off the gate by dropping to <=800 LOC.

Ten pure/IO leaf utility symbols (none taking _PassContext) are extracted into a new sibling leaf module reconcile_helpers.py (~497 LOC) that lazy-loads its own siblings and imports nothing from reconcile.py.
reconcile.py re-exports all ten moved symbols as module-level names so they remain resolvable as reconcile.<symbol> for existing by-path tests.
Two stale in-tree comments asserting route_inbound_probe resides in reconcile.py are corrected in reconcile.py and run_differs.py to state it now lives in reconcile_helpers.py and is re-exported.

The change supersedes the architecture.md remedy row proposing a reconcile_passes.py seam, since moving _PassContext-driven phase helpers would create a back-edge or require three modules; that remedy row is deleted from docs.
This is a mechanical move-plus-re-export refactor with no signature or logic changes, validated by the existing reconciler unit suite, module-size contract test, and lint.
